messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "rhinoceros", "beetle"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large four-legged mammal shown in side view facing right. The body, head, legs and paws are covered in thick shaggy brown fur with a lighter tan muzzle and underbelly, like a bear. The head is bear-like with small rounded ears on top and dark eyes on the sides. A single long curved black horn projects upward from the tip of the nose. The entire back from behind the neck to the rump is covered by a large glossy dark-brown domed shell in two main sections with fine lengthwise lines and a segmented rim around the lower edge. The legs are thick and columnar and end in broad flat paws with long pale claws. No wings or distinct tail are visible.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "furry brown bear head with lighter tan muzzle and dark eyes", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body"}, {"looks_like": "long curved black pointed horn like a rhinoceros horn", "part": "horn", "where": "on the tip of the nose"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head"}, {"looks_like": "thick shaggy brown fur with lighter underbelly", "part": "fur", "where": "covering the head, body and legs"}, {"looks_like": "thick furry brown bear legs", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in rear"}, {"looks_like": "broad flat furry paws with long pale claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs"}, {"looks_like": "glossy dark-brown domed hard shell with two main sections and a segmented rim", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the back from shoulders to rump"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 0, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
